summary: WIN-041 patch 2 (ISS-2603 fix) shipped with wrong DOI: Terra-Nova et al. 2017 link resolves to an unrelated seismic-profiling paper (Katou et al., GJI 212:509-521). Correct DOI is 10.1016/j.pepi.2017.03.002 (already used by WIN-004). Exact-replacement patch in EXP-593.
detail: Mode 2b re-verification of decider's 2026-06-06 WIN-041 5-patch integration (commit d4fa543). Patch 2 added the boundary-decay rebuttal recommended by WIN-041.c3 holes_found[1], hyperlinking Terra-Nova et al. 2017 to https://doi.org/10.1093/gji/ggx374. CrossRef confirms that DOI is Katou et al. 'Reciprocal data acquisition and subsequent waveform matching for integrated onshore-offshore seismic profiling' — wrong paper. The substance of the rebuttal otherwise verifies (Finlay 2020 CHAOS-7 abstract confirms the reversed-flux/secondary-minimum mechanism; axisymmetry argument matches dome baseline parameters). This is a checkable factual error in the exact paragraph that answers the dome's strongest current WIN-041 argument — high credibility exposure, trivial fix. EXP-593 carries two exact old_string/new_string patches (seq 1 required DOI fix; seq 2 optional Finlay 2020 cite for the uncited CHAOS-7 clause) plus the verdict assessment the decider requested: KEEP Misleading. Rebuild docs/index.html after patching (wrong DOI propagated into generated HTML).
